title: In-app parent confirmation notifications for phone-based pairing (frontend)

requirements.summary: Surface pending phone pairing confirmation requests to parents in the dashboard and allow one-click confirmation.
acceptanceCriteria: In the parent experience (e.g., ParentDashboard), if there is at least one pending phone confirmation request for the logged-in parent, the UI displays a clear alert/banner/card indicating a child is requesting to link via phone number.
The alert includes a single primary action to confirm the request; clicking it triggers the backend confirm call and shows a success toast/message on completion.
After confirmation, parent UI updates without a full refresh (React Query invalidation/refetch) and the pending alert disappears.
All new user-facing text added for this feature is in English and wired through the existing i18n system (update the English dictionary at minimum).

file_operations.description: Add React Query hooks for the parent confirmation flow using existing backend capabilities: a query hook to fetch pending pairing requests for the current parent (via getPendingPairingRequests) and a mutation hook to confirm a request (via acceptPendingPairing). Ensure the confirm mutation invalidates/refetches relevant keys (at minimum: ['myChildren'], and the pending-requests query key), and shows success/error toasts consistent with existing patterns. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Add a parent-facing pending confirmation alert/banner/card at the top of the dashboard content area that appears when there are one or more pending requests for the logged-in parent. The alert should include a single primary Confirm action that triggers the new confirm mutation; on success, show a success toast/message and ensure the UI updates via React Query invalidation so the alert disappears without a full refresh. Keep the feature accessible only in the parent UI path already guarded by role-based routing (authorization component already drives authenticated/role-gated access in App.tsx). Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Add English i18n keys for the parent pending confirmation alert (title/body), confirm button label, and success/failure toast messages for confirming a pending phone pairing request. Ensure ParentDashboard uses t(...) for all new strings. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Update child phone pairing flow to show a pending parent-confirmation state (no OTP) and poll/refetch until pairing is completed.
acceptanceCriteria: In the child pairing UI (PairWithParentCard), submitting a phone number that matches a parent creates a pending confirmation request and the UI indicates the request was sent and is awaiting parent confirmation.
The child UI does not require SMS/OTP entry to complete this confirmation flow.
Once the parent confirms, the child UI reflects that pairing is completed (e.g., by refetching useGetMyParent and showing the paired state card).

React Query hooks are added/updated in frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts to support creating the request, fetching pending status (as needed), and confirming requests; queries/mutations correctly invalidate existing keys like ['myParent'] and ['myChildren'] after confirmation.

file_operations.description: Update existing phone pairing query/mutation support to handle the new pending confirmation flow: ensure usePairWithParentViaPhone cleanly returns/propagates PairWithParentResult.pendingLinkRequest, and update useGetMyParent to optionally accept query options (e.g., refetchInterval) so the child UI can poll while awaiting confirmation. Keep existing behavior for other phone results to avoid regressions. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Adjust the phone-based pairing UI so that when pairWithParentViaPhone returns pendingLinkRequest, the component transitions into a new 'pending parent confirmation' state (instead of OTP entry), displays a clear waiting message, and starts polling/refetching (e.g., by enabling a refetchInterval on useGetMyParent while pending). When pairing is eventually established, the existing paired state card should render automatically. Preserve the existing OTP UI only for cases where the backend returns phoneVerificationInitiated, but do not require OTP for the pending confirmation flow. All new strings must use i18n. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Add English i18n keys for the child's pending-confirmation state (title/body), optional helper text (e.g., polling note), and any toasts shown after submitting the phone number when the result is pendingLinkRequest. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
